definitions.explanation: A plain white flag used as a symbol of surrender, truce, or ceasefire. Also used figuratively to mean giving up.

examples.japanese: {白旗|しらはた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。
⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{白旗|しらはた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}って→振る：01983_furu⟧⟦{降伏|こうふく}した→降伏する：20577_koufukusuru⟧。
examples.english: The enemy waved a white flag and surrendered.

examples.japanese: あまり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{白旗|しらはた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げて→上げる：02443_ageru⟧しまった。
examples.english: The problem was so difficult that I gave up.

notes:
{白旗|しらはた} is a white flag used as a universal symbol of surrender, truce, or ceasefire. It is also used figuratively in everyday Japanese to mean giving up or admitting defeat. The word can also be read しろ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧た, but しらはた is the standard reading.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {白旗|しらはた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to raise a white flag; to surrender
- {白旗|しらはた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧: to wave a white flag

The expression {白旗|しらはた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ is frequently used figuratively to mean giving up on a task or challenge.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{赤旗|あかはた}→赤旗：28002_akahata⟧: red flag (danger signal, or the communist flag)
- ⟦{旗印|はたじるし}→旗印：27807_hatajirushi⟧: banner; rallying symbol
